oracle_snapshots.name: Doctor Doom, King of Latveria
oracle_snapshots.text:
Whenever you discard one or more land cards, each opponent loses 2 life.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target Villain you control gains menace until end of turn. It connives. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.)

strategy.primary: Lands as discard ammunition: discard land cards in separate events (cycling, Trade Routes, Seismic Assault, Psychic Frog, rummaging) so each event drains every opponent for 2, then recover the lands (Crucible, Moonstone, Containment Construct) and repeat.
strategy.secondary: Villain/connive shell: Doom's combat connive on a Villain plus Lethal Scheme, Kang, Ultron, Glorious Purpose; Doom trigger copies (Chameleon, Spark Double, Roaming Throne) and the Tectonic Reformation + Surly Badgersaur + Dakmor Salvage infinite.

identity.why: Free, repeatable land-discard outlet: one Doom trigger per activation.
Each land discard is a separate event: Doom drain plus 2 damage.
Replays discarded lands so the ammunition doesn't run out.
Renewable land to discard; centre of the infinite.
